# Selected examples

```{r}
highlighted_proteins <- c("CD4", "CD6", "CD8A", "CXCL10", "CXCL13", "LTA4H", "NOS3", 
                          "CD48", "FABP2", "LAG3", "CCN1", "FABP5", "DPEP2", "PAG1")

p_up <- data_long %>%
  dplyr::select(DAid, Assay, NPX) %>%
  right_join(metadata, by = "DAid") %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Assay %in% highlighted_proteins,
    Subcategory %in% desired_order
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Assay = factor(Assay, levels = highlighted_proteins),
    Subcategory = factor(Subcategory, levels = desired_order),

    # 🔑 NEW: split baseline/follow-up except Healthy
    Subcategory_time = dplyr::case_when(
      Subcategory == "Healthy" ~ "Healthy",
      TRUE ~ paste(Subcategory, Timepoint, sep = " – ")
    )
  )

x_order <- c(
  "Primary HIV Infection – Baseline",
  "Primary HIV Infection – Follow-up",
  "More preserved immunity – Baseline",
  "More preserved immunity – Follow-up",
  "Severely impaired immunity – Baseline",
  "Severely impaired immunity – Follow-up",
  "Elite Controller – Baseline",
  "Elite Controller – Follow-up",
  "Healthy"
)

p_up$Subcategory_time <- factor(p_up$Subcategory_time, levels = x_order)

p_up_plot <- ggplot(
  p_up,
  aes(
    x     = Subcategory_time,
    y     = NPX,
    color = Subcategory,
    fill  = Subcategory
  )
) +
  geom_quasirandom(
    alpha  = 0.7,
    stroke = 0,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    color = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Assay, ncol = 7, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = subcategory_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = subcategory_colors) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 75, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Expression of Selected Proteins by Cohort and Timepoint",
    x     = "Cohort / Timepoint",
    y     = "NPX"
  )

print(p_up_plot)

ggsave(
  filename = "boxplot_selected_proteins_HIV_vs_healthy_baseline_paired.pdf",
  plot     = p_up_plot,
  path     = "../plots/pdf/boxplot/",
  width    = 30,
  height   = 10
)

ggsave(
  filename = "boxplot_selected_proteins_HIV_vs_healthy_baseline_paired.png",
  plot     = p_up_plot,
  path     = "../plots/png/boxplot/",
  width    = 30,
  height   = 10
)
```

# All proteins

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(ggforce)

# ---- Parameters ----
proteins_per_page <- 30
ncol_facets <- 5
nrow_facets <- 6

# ---- Prepare plotting data ----
p_all <- data_long %>%
  dplyr::select(DAid, Assay, NPX) %>%
  right_join(metadata, by = "DAid") %>%
  mutate(
    Subcategory_time = dplyr::case_when(
      Subcategory == "Healthy" ~ "Healthy",
      TRUE ~ paste(Subcategory, Timepoint, sep = " – ")
    )
  )

# ---- Define your desired x-axis order ----
x_order <- c(
  "Primary HIV Infection – Baseline",
  "Primary HIV Infection – Follow-up",
  "More preserved immunity – Baseline",
  "More preserved immunity – Follow-up",
  "Severely impaired immunity – Baseline",
  "Severely impaired immunity – Follow-up",
  "Elite Controller – Baseline",
  "Elite Controller – Follow-up",
  "Healthy"
)

p_all$Subcategory_time <- factor(p_all$Subcategory_time, levels = x_order)

# ---- Get unique proteins and batch into chunks of 30 ----
all_proteins <- unique(p_all$Assay)
protein_chunks <- split(all_proteins, ceiling(seq_along(all_proteins) / proteins_per_page))

# ---- Output PDF ----
pdf("../plots/pdf/boxplot/all_proteins_boxplots_paged.pdf", width = 20, height = 14)

for (i in seq_along(protein_chunks)) {
  chunk <- protein_chunks[[i]]
  
  message("📄 Plotting page ", i, " with ", length(chunk), " proteins...")
  
  df_chunk <- p_all %>% filter(Assay %in% chunk)
  
  p_chunk <- ggplot(
    df_chunk,
    aes(
      x = Subcategory_time,
      y = NPX,
      color = Subcategory,
      fill = Subcategory
    )
  ) +
    geom_quasirandom(alpha = 0.5, stroke = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(color = "black", outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ Assay, ncol = ncol_facets, nrow = nrow_facets, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = subcategory_colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = subcategory_colors) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme_hiv() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 75, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Protein Expression (page", i, "of", length(protein_chunks), ")"),
      y = "NPX"
    )
  
  print(p_chunk)
}

dev.off()
message("✅ Multi-page PDF saved to ../plots/pdf/boxplot/all_proteins_boxplots_paged.pdf")

```


# Boxplots

```{r}
subcategory_colors <- c(
  "Primary HIV Infection"       = "#9FBFBA",  # teal / blue-green
  "Severely impaired immunity" = "#C97A73",  # mustard yellow
  "More preserved immunity"    = "#E3C35B",  # muted red
  "Elite Controller"           = "#6B6FA9",  # blue-purple
  "Healthy"                    = "#BDBDBD"   # neutral grey
)
```

```{r}
highlighted_proteins <- de_results$de_res |>
  filter(logFC > 0.5) |>
  arrange(adj.P.Val) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  bind_rows(
    de_results$de_res |>
      filter(logFC < -0.5) |>
      arrange(adj.P.Val) |>
      slice_head(n = 5)
  ) |>
  pull(Feature)

desired_order <- c(
  "Primary HIV Infection",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Elite Controller",
  "Healthy"
)

p_up <- data_long %>%
  dplyr::select(DAid, Assay, NPX) %>%
  right_join(
    metadata %>% filter(Timepoint != "Follow-up"),
    by = "DAid"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Assay %in% highlighted_proteins,
    Subcategory %in% desired_order
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Assay       = factor(Assay, levels = highlighted_proteins),
    Subcategory = factor(Subcategory, levels = desired_order)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x     = Subcategory,
    y     = NPX,
    color = Subcategory,
    fill  = Subcategory
  )) +
    geom_quasirandom(
      alpha  = 0.7,
      stroke = 0,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      color = "black",
      outlier.shape = NA,
      alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ Assay, ncol = 5, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = subcategory_colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = subcategory_colors) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Expression of Selected Proteins by Cohort",
      x     = "Cohort",
      y     = "NPX"
    ) +
  theme_hiv() +
  # tilt the x-axis text 45 degrees
  theme(
    axis.text.x    = element_text(angle = 65, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  # remove x-axis text
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )

print(p_up)

ggsave(
  filename = "boxplot_top_differential_proteins_HIV_vs_healthy.pdf",
  plot     = p_up,
  path     = "../plots/pdf/boxplot/",
  width    = 12,
  height   = 8
)

ggsave(
  filename = "boxplot_top_differential_proteins_HIV_vs_healthy.png",
  plot     = p_up,
  path     = "../plots/png/boxplot/",
  width    = 12,
  height   = 8
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)

# ---------------------------
# Desired ordering
# ---------------------------
desired_order <- c(
  "Primary HIV Infection",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Elite Controller",
  "Healthy",
  "Cardiovascular",
  "Metabolic"
)

subcategory_colors <- c(
  "Primary HIV Infection"     = "#D55E00",
  "More preserved immunity"   = "#0072B2",
  "Severely impaired immunity"= "#CC79A7",
  "Elite Controller"          = "#009E73",
  "Healthy"                   = "#71BF6E",
  "Cardiovascular"            = "#FC8D62",  # ✅ requested
  "Metabolic"                 = "#E5C494"   # ✅ requested
)


highlighted_proteins <- c(
  "LEP", "IL10", "IGFBP2", "CXCL13", "CNDP1",
  "GFAP", "WFDC2", "CCL20", "AGRP", "KLK13",
  "DDX58", "SLAMF8", "ASAH2", "SORD", "GZMH"
)

# ---------------------------
# Prepare plotting data
# ---------------------------
p_up <- hdba_data_all_long %>%
  select(DAid, Assay, NPX) %>%
  inner_join(
    metadata |> bind_rows(hdba_metadata),
    by = "DAid"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Assay %in% highlighted_proteins,
    Subcategory %in% desired_order
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Assay = factor(Assay, levels = highlighted_proteins),
    Subcategory = factor(Subcategory, levels = desired_order),

    # ✅ FIX: correct handling of timepoint splitting
    Subcategory_time = case_when(
  Subcategory %in% c("Healthy", "Cardiovascular", "Metabolic") ~ Subcategory,
  TRUE ~ paste(Subcategory, Timepoint, sep = " – ")
)

  )

# ---------------------------
# Explicit x-axis order
# ---------------------------
x_order <- c(
  "Primary HIV Infection – Baseline",
  "Primary HIV Infection – Follow-up",
  "More preserved immunity – Baseline",
  "More preserved immunity – Follow-up",
  "Severely impaired immunity – Baseline",
  "Severely impaired immunity – Follow-up",
  "Elite Controller – Baseline",
  "Elite Controller – Follow-up",
  "Healthy",
  "Cardiovascular",
  "Metabolic"
)

p_up$Subcategory_time <- factor(p_up$Subcategory_time, levels = x_order)

# ---------------------------
# Plot
# ---------------------------
p_up_plot <- ggplot(
  p_up,
  aes(
    x     = Subcategory_time,
    y     = NPX,
    color = Subcategory,
    fill  = Subcategory,
    group = Subcategory_time
  )
) +
  geom_quasirandom(
    alpha  = 0.7,
    stroke = 0,
    width  = 0.25,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    color = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Assay, ncol = 5, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = subcategory_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = subcategory_colors) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 75, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Expression of Selected Proteins by Cohort and Timepoint",
    x     = "Cohort / Timepoint",
    y     = "NPX"
  )


# ---------------------------
# Save
# ---------------------------
ggsave(
  filename = "boxplot_selected_proteins_HIV_FU_CVD_MET.pdf",
  plot     = p_up_plot,
  path     = "../plots/pdf/boxplot/",
  width    = 30,
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)

# ---------------------------
# Desired ordering
# ---------------------------
desired_order <- c(
  "Primary HIV Infection",
  "More preserved immunity",
  "Severely impaired immunity",
  "Elite Controller",
  "Healthy",
  "Cardiovascular",
  "Metabolic"
)

# ---------------------------
# Subcategory colors
# ---------------------------
subcategory_colors <- c(
  "Primary HIV Infection"      = "#D55E00",
  "More preserved immunity"    = "#0072B2",
  "Severely impaired immunity" = "#CC79A7",
  "Elite Controller"           = "#009E73",
  "Healthy"                    = "#71BF6E",
  "Cardiovascular"             = "#FC8D62",
  "Metabolic"                  = "#E5C494"
)

# ---------------------------
# Highlighted proteins
# ---------------------------
highlighted_proteins <- c(
  "LEP", "IL10", "IGFBP2", "CXCL13", "CNDP1",
  "GFAP", "WFDC2", "CCL20", "AGRP", "KLK13",
  "DDX58", "SLAMF8", "ASAH2", "SORD", "GZMH"
)

# ---------------------------
# Prepare plotting data
# ---------------------------
p_up <- data_long |> bind_rows(hdba_data_long) %>%
  select(DAid, Assay, NPX) %>%
  inner_join(
    metadata |> bind_rows(hdba_metadata),
    by = "DAid"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Assay %in% highlighted_proteins,
    Subcategory %in% desired_order
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Assay       = factor(Assay, levels = highlighted_proteins),
    Subcategory = factor(Subcategory, levels = desired_order),

    # ✅ FINAL, ROBUST LOGIC
    Subcategory_time = if_else(
      Subcategory %in% c(
        "Primary HIV Infection",
        "More preserved immunity",
        "Severely impaired immunity",
        "Elite Controller"
      ),
      paste(Subcategory, Timepoint, sep = " – "),
      as.character(Subcategory)
    )
  )



# ---------------------------
# Explicit x-axis order
# ---------------------------
x_order <- c(
  "Primary HIV Infection – Baseline",
  "Primary HIV Infection – Follow-up",
  "More preserved immunity – Baseline",
  "More preserved immunity – Follow-up",
  "Severely impaired immunity – Baseline",
  "Severely impaired immunity – Follow-up",
  "Elite Controller – Baseline",
  "Elite Controller – Follow-up",
  "Healthy",
  "Cardiovascular",
  "Metabolic"
)

p_up$Subcategory_time <- factor(p_up$Subcategory_time, levels = x_order)

# ---------------------------
# Plot
# ---------------------------
p_up_plot <- ggplot(
  p_up,
  aes(
    x     = Subcategory_time,
    y     = NPX,
    color = Subcategory,
    fill  = Subcategory,
    group = Subcategory_time
  )
) +
  geom_quasirandom(
    alpha  = 0.7,
    stroke = 0,
    width  = 0.25,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    color = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Assay, ncol = 5, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = subcategory_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = subcategory_colors) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme_hiv() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 75, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Expression of Selected Proteins by Cohort and Timepoint",
    x     = "Cohort / Timepoint",
    y     = "NPX"
  )

print(p_up_plot)

# ---------------------------
# Save
# ---------------------------
ggsave(
  filename = "boxplot_selected_proteins_HIV_FU_CVD_MET.pdf",
  plot     = p_up_plot,
  path     = "../plots/pdf/boxplot/",
  width    = 24,
  height   = 14
)

ggsave(

  plot     = p_up_plot,
  path     = "../plots/png/boxplot/",
  width    = 24,
  height   = 14
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)

highlighted_proteins <- c(
  "FABP2", "LEP", "IGFBP2", "DGKZ"
)

# ---------------------------
# Treatments of interest
# ---------------------------
treatment_order <- c(
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir",
  "INSTI + Abacavir"
)

# ---------------------------
# Prepare plotting data
# ---------------------------
p_up <- data_long |> 
  bind_rows(hdba_data_long) %>%
  select(DAid, Assay, NPX) %>%
  inner_join(
    metadata |> bind_rows(hdba_metadata),
    by = "DAid"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Assay %in% highlighted_proteins,
    Treatment %in% treatment_order |
      Subcategory %in% c("Healthy", "Elite Controller")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Assay = factor(Assay, levels = highlighted_proteins),

    # HIV: Treatment × Timepoint
    # Healthy & EC: single reference group
    Group_time = case_when(
      Subcategory == "Healthy" ~ "Healthy",
      Subcategory == "Elite Controller" ~ "Elite Controller",
      TRUE ~ paste(Treatment, Timepoint, sep = " – ")
    )
  )

# ---------------------------
# Explicit x-axis order
# ---------------------------
x_order <- c(
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir – Baseline",
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir – Follow-up",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir – Baseline",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir – Follow-up",
  "INSTI + Abacavir – Baseline",
  "INSTI + Abacavir – Follow-up",
  "Healthy",
  "Elite Controller"
)

p_up$Group_time <- factor(p_up$Group_time, levels = x_order)

# ---------------------------
# Plot
# ---------------------------
p_up_plot <- ggplot(
  p_up,
  aes(
    x = Group_time,
    y = NPX,
    group = Group_time
  )
) +

  ) +

  ) +

  theme_hiv() +

    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Expression of Selected Proteins by Treatment, Timepoint, and Reference Groups",
```

# CD4/CD8 ratio

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)

# 1. Compute delta CD4/CD8 for each sample
cd4_cd8_df <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease != "Healthy") %>%
  mutate(`delta_CD4CD8` = `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)` - `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`)

# 2. Calculate Elite Controller median CD4/CD8 ratio as reference
ec_median <- metadata %>%
  filter(Subcategory == "Elite Controller") %>%
  summarise(EC_CD4CD8_median = median(`CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)` -`CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)`, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(EC_CD4CD8_median)

# 3. Prepare data for plotting
cd4_cd8_df <- cd4_cd8_df %>%
  filter(Subcategory != "Elite Controller") %>%
  drop_na(`delta_CD4CD8`, Treatment) |>
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# 4. Calculate sample counts per Treatment × Subcategory
n_labels <- cd4_cd8_df %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Subcategory) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(
    cd4_cd8_df %>%
      group_by(Treatment, Subcategory) %>%
      summarise(y_pos = max(`delta_CD4CD8`, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
    by = c("Treatment", "Subcategory")
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("n=", n))

# 5. Plot CD4/CD8 change with EC reference
ggplot(cd4_cd8_df, aes(x = Treatment, y = `delta_CD4CD8`, fill = Subcategory)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(group = interaction(Treatment, Subcategory)),
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.7,
    width = 0.6,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
  ) +
  geom_quasirandom(
    aes(color = Subcategory, group = interaction(Treatment, Subcategory)),
    dodge.width = 0.8,
    varwidth = TRUE,
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  # Add sample count labels
  geom_text(
    data = n_labels,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = y_pos + 0.05, label = label, group = Subcategory, color = Subcategory),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    size = 3.8,
    vjust = 0
  ) +
  # Add grey dashed line at y=0 (no change)
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  # Add red line for EC median CD4/CD8 ratio (optional)
  geom_hline(yintercept = ec_median, color = "red", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = ec_median, label = "Elite Controller median", hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5, color = "red", size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "More preserved immunity" = "#d95f02",
    "Severely impaired immunity" = "#7570b3",
    "Primary HIV Infection" = "#e7298a"
  )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "More preserved immunity" = "#d95f02",
    "Severely impaired immunity" = "#7570b3",
    "Primary HIV Infection" = "#e7298a"
  )) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Change in CD4/CD8 ratio by Treatment and Subcategory\nwith Elite Controller median reference",
    y = expression(Delta*" CD4/CD8 ratio"),
    x = "Treatment",
    fill = "Subcategory"
  )

ggsave("../plots/pdf/boxplot/cd4_cd8_change_by_treatment.pdf", width = 10, height = 7)
ggsave("../plots/png/boxplot/cd4_cd8_change_by_treatment.png", width = 10, height = 7)

```

## Simplified

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)

# ---------------------------
# 0. Define treatment levels
# ---------------------------
treatment_levels <- c(
  "INSTI + Abacavir",
  "INSTI + Tenofovir",
  "NNRTI + Tenofovir",
  "Untreated",
  "Other"
)

# ---------------------------
# 1. Compute Δ CD4/CD8 and harmonise treatments
# ---------------------------
cd4_cd8_df <- metadata %>%
  filter(Disease == "HIV") %>%
  mutate(
    delta_CD4CD8 =
      `CD4/CD8 ratio (follow-up)` -
      `CD4/CD8 ratio (baseline)`,

    # Handle missing treatment
    Treatment = if_else(is.na(Treatment), "Other", Treatment),

    # Elite Controllers are untreated
    Treatment = if_else(
      Subcategory == "Elite Controller",
      "Untreated",
      Treatment
    ),

    # Collapse everything else into "Other"
    Treatment = if_else(
      Treatment %in% treatment_levels,
      Treatment,
      "Other"
    ),

    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = treatment_levels)
  ) %>%
  drop_na(delta_CD4CD8, Treatment) |>
  distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---------------------------
# 2. Sample counts per Treatment × Subcategory
# ---------------------------
n_labels <- cd4_cd8_df %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Subcategory) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    y_pos = max(delta_CD4CD8, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("n=", n))

# ---------------------------
# 3. Plot
# ---------------------------
p_cd4 <- ggplot(
  cd4_cd8_df,
  aes(
    x = Treatment,
    y = delta_CD4CD8,
    fill = Subcategory
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(group = interaction(Treatment, Subcategory)),
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.7,
    width = 0.6,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
  ) +
  geom_quasirandom(
    aes(
      color = Subcategory,
      group = interaction(Treatment, Subcategory)
    ),
    dodge.width = 0.8,
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = n_labels,
    aes(
      x = Treatment,
      y = y_pos + 0.05,
      label = label,
      color = Subcategory,
      group = Subcategory
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    size = 3.8,
    vjust = 0
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Elite Controller"          = "#1b9e77",
    "More preserved immunity"   = "#d95f02",
    "Severely impaired immunity"= "#7570b3",
    "Primary HIV Infection"     = "#e7298a"
  )) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Elite Controller"          = "#1b9e77",
    "More preserved immunity"   = "#d95f02",
    "Severely impaired immunity"= "#7570b3",
    "Primary HIV Infection"     = "#e7298a"
  )) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Change in CD4/CD8 ratio by treatment and HIV subcategory",
    subtitle = "Elite Controllers included in the Untreated group",
    y = expression(Delta * " CD4/CD8 ratio"),
    x = "Treatment",
    fill = "Subcategory",
    color = "Subcategory"
  )

print(p_cd4)

# ---------------------------
# 4. Save
# ---------------------------
ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/boxplot/cd4_cd8_change_by_treatment_untreated.pdf",
  width = 10, height = 7
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/boxplot/cd4_cd8_change_by_treatment_untreated.png",
  width = 10, height = 7
)
```
